tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tsa tur mu kha'i gtor mdos zung 'brel bzhugs so// oṃ 'grub par gyur cig 'dir bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rdo rje nag po chen po tsa tur mu kha'i gtor mdos zung 'brel gyi bzlog gzhung ltar gtong rim gnang ba de las 'dir cung zad bsdus te gtang tshul/ de yang da lam sa phag dbyug zla'i dus gtor chen mo dang chabs cig bgyis pa'i dbang du btang nas phur gtor lnga/ sman raka dam rdzas bcu tshar/ bkram bskang nag po mchod rten/ mchod pa 'bul gtor tshogs sogs dus gtor sor bzhag gtor bzlog bcas shom tshang ma rang re'i lag len la gang yod bzhin dang / mdos shom gzhung na gsal po 'dug pas/ de bzhin sgrig pa ni sbyor ba'i zin tho dang / dngos gzhir dus gtor tshogs nas sngon 'gro gtor ma rgyun bzhin gnas yo byin brlabs rol mo byin 'bebs sogs dus gtor la gang thob rnams tshogs kyi bshags pa grub par rgyun bzhin spar chag med par btang / gtor bzlog gi mchod pa byin rlabs/ gtor ma byin brlabs rgyun bzhin byas nas mdos dang yo byad sngags drug phyag drug gis byin brlabs bsangs bzhin la/ gtor ma dang mchod rdzas zhes sogs tshig gzhan rnams mi brjod par sngags dang phyag rgyas don tshang / zhal bskyed chog nas/ mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol bar rgyun/ 'jig rten khams kyi ma tshig bskang gso bzhin la/ bar chad bzlog phyir bzhes su gsol/ zhes bsgyur/ rol mo'i mtha'i gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa rdzogs pa dang myos byed steng gi nas/ gsang ba bdud brtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di bar rgyun bzhin/ zhal bzhi gnyen po'i zhal du 'bul/ bar chad bzlog phyir bzhes su gsol la tshig rol chems brdung sbugs la sngags thung mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes sbyar/ gsum brdegs len can stobs chen ma'i dbyangs rol dam tshig bskang gso bzhin la/

bar chad bzlog phyir bzhes su gsol/ zhes tshig bsgyur gang dgos rigs 'gre sbyar nas mjug gi tshig rol bar dam tshig bskang gso bzhin/ dur khrod gnas brgyad ma dam tshig bskang gso bzhin/ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs las sogs kyang dam tshig bskang gso bzhin/ thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlags pa'i phrin las mdzod kyi rol mo nam gyi rjes su/ zhwa gyon sbraṃ sbraṃ gcig gnyis gsum tshogs dgu brdung spyi 'gre rdzogs pa'i nas/ 'di sgrubs shig bar rgyun bzhin gyi mthar chems brdung sbraṃ gcig gnyis zhes rnga rol bzhag zhwa gyon bzhin sngags thung sum brgya bzla ba na/ rang gshed rang la phob mdzad cig bar rgyun gyi gtor bzlog bzhin/ dus gsum sangs rgyas nas/ phyag nas bskyod bar da lam gyi dpe cha de nas 'dzin dgos dang / sdig can la tshig rol dgu brdung chems brdung liṅga sgrol ba nas/ gsol kha rdzogs bar rgyun gyi gtor bzlog bzhin/ gsol kha lnga pa'i chems brdung rdzogs nas zhwa gyon/ gsum brdegs len can/ hūm̐ 'jig rten nas/ srog chags nag pos gzugs kyis bskang bar lha mchog ma'i gdangs gsum nyin re re rol mo dang bcas pa/ nag po nas gyur cig bar 'dur shur gang rung / mchod yon me tog nas cig bar rakta dmar chen ma'i dbyangs rol/ dam rdzas nas spos kyi du ba yi bar/ dam rdzas rgyan dang ma'i dbyangs rol de phyir 'dur shur gang rung / bdag cag la gdong bzhir grang pa'i dbyangs rol/ dpa' bo nas/ ngan sdig bar 'dur shur gang rung / ngan sdig la tshig rol/ hūm̐ḥlha chen nag po gnod sbyin ma'i dbyangs rol/ tshogs bdag nas 'dur shur gang rung / bcol ba'i tshig rol rjes dgu brdung gnyis/ rnga phyi rdung / glu bdag la tshig rol dgu rdung / bzlog pa tshar gsum gyi rjes dmar tshig rol dgu brdung chems rdung / sbraṃ gcig gnyis zhes rnga rol bzhag sngags ring oṃ nas/ um bar/ sngags thung / oṃ nas/

tri ta hūm̐/ phaṭa bar/ zor sngags e nas/ a la la bzlog bhyoḥ 'ur 'don sbrel ba nyer gcig phur bzlog gi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu'i 'og bzhir rol mo blangs la mngon spyod rol pa rgyun bzhin/ 'on kyang mngon spyod rol pa'i sde tshan rdzogs 'phral spyi bstabs yong rgyun yin 'dug cing / mjug chos dus gtor bzhin/ 'phen nyin kye bos dang mngon spyod rol pa bzhag phyir thod skabs kye bos nas/ mtheb skyu 'phen par rgyun bzhin/ de ba'i chems brdung rdzogs pa dang gsum brdegs len can/ nag po chen po dam tshig bskang gso bzhin/ 'di longs shig gi rol mo nam rdzogs pa dang / sbraṃ gcig gnyis zhes sogs rol bskor bzhi brdung dang sdigs mdzub kyi dzaṃ len tshul mgon mdos bzhin bcas mdos mer 'phang yang / zor gtor la dzaṃ blangs la/ de rjes 'phen pa man shes pas de bzhin no/ /zhes pa'ang sa skya pa kun blos mgyogs bris stabs bde'i zin bris so// //dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ tsaturmukha'i gtor mdos zung 'brel/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
